notes: Expanded Clarinet, Pedal Steel Guitar, Cello, Sitar, Double Bass, and Tabla from starter sets into researched SoundTrail maps with meaningful style coverage.
Every SoundTrail instrument now includes a why-it-matters overview and public research provenance.
Every listed SoundTrail style now includes an explanation of the instrument's role, research provenance, and at least one verified recording example.
TinyFish is now the default broad-web research pass for newly added SoundTrail instruments, with Spotify verification kept separate from music-history research.
Removed the empty generic Tabla 'Indian Classical' bucket in favor of specific solo and accompaniment contexts.
SoundTrail catalog validation now rejects missing instrument importance, missing research provenance, missing style explanations, and styles without recording examples.
